//: Not a workspace package (pnpm-workspace.yaml globs apps/* and packages/*, not apps/web/e2e). This manifest exists ONLY to declare the module format of the Playwright E2E graph, and mirrors apps/desktop/e2e/package.json. Playwright decides per file whether to emit ESM or CommonJS from the nearest package.json `type` (transform/esmLoader.js: `isRequire ? 'commonjs' : fileIsModule(filename) ? 'module' : 'commonjs'`). apps/web has no `type`, so without this file every spec is CommonJS, and every ESM-only workspace library it reaches (@brainstrike/utils, @brainstrike/logging, @brainstrike/file-system — all `type: module` since BST-1014) is force-transpiled to CommonJS. That breaks two ways: `import.meta` cannot be represented in CommonJS, and `export *` becomes a runtime getter loop that cjs-module-lexer cannot see through, so static named imports of re-exported bindings fail to link. Web had been paying for this one import at a time — background-indexing-settings.test.ts avoided the @brainstrike/utils barrel because it re-exports env-utils/hmr-utils — which held only for as long as no spec reached a barrel, a constraint nothing enforced. scripts/__tests__/e2e-module-format-contract.test.mjs now enforces it. See BST-1217.
